The '''colossus wasp of Ithull''', also known as the '''Ithullan colossus wasp''', was a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long [[Insect/Legends|insect]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithull]] and traveled between the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of the [[Stenness Node]] region, where it [[Diet/Legends|fed]] on [[Star/Legends|stellar]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], [[Cosmic ray/Legends|cosmic rays]], [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-dwelling creatures. The wasps had a thick [[exoskeleton]] and were well-adapted for interstellar travel, spending most of the [[Time/Legends|time]] off their homeworld and only returning for [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]].

More than four [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the husks of [[Death/Legends|dead]] colossus wasps that were drifting in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] inspired the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of the [[Nessie]] [[Species/Legends|species']] group to attempt to convert them into [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] for [[Ore hauler|transporting]] valuable [[mutonium]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to further-shipping points. By [[3999 BBY]], after [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of research into the prospect, the construction of the [[Starship/Legends|starships]], known as the [[Ithullan ore hauler]]s, had begun. During the building of the vessels, the internal organs of the colossus wasp bodies were cleaned out, leaving only the hollow [[Skeleton/Legends|exoskeletons]], which were then outfitted with ore holds and the necessary starship systems, including [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and electronics. In addition, the thick exoskeleton itself was augmented with [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] for defense.

Although the manufacturers of the Ithullan ore haulers claimed they only used naturally occurring husks of dead colossus wasps, the demand for the exoskeletons led to the emergence of the practice of [[Hunting/Legends|poaching]] the creatures. Eventually, the construction of the ore haulers led to colossus wasps becoming rare and possibly even extinct.

==Biology and appearance==
The colossus wasp,<ref name="CSWE Ithull">{{CSWECite|II|124|Ithull}}</ref> known fully as the colossus wasp of Ithull<ref name="CSWE ColossusWasp">{{CSWECite|I|134|colossus wasps of Ithull}}</ref> or alternatively as the Ithullan colossus wasp,<ref name="CSWE IthullanOreHauler">{{CSWECite|II|124|Ithullan ore hauler}}</ref> was a type of flying<ref name="CSWE ColossusWasp" /> [[Insect/Legends|insect]]<ref name="TotJC" /> that reached a length between 1 and 1.5 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. The wasp had a standard insect body structure that consisted of a head<ref name="EGtVV" /> with a [[Bone/Legends|skull]],<ref name="FF114" /> a thorax with three pairs of attached segmented [[Limb/Legends|legs]], and an [[Stomach/Legends|abdomen]].<ref name="EGtVV" /> The body's interior held several organs such as a [[Heart/Legends|heart]], [[Lung/Legends|lungs]], [[Brain/Legends|brains]], and the [[Diet/Legends|digestive]] system.<ref name="FF114" />

[[File:IthullanOreHauler-EGtVV.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The schematics of an Ithullan ore hauler constructed out of a colossus wasp exoskeleton]]
A pair of large,<ref name="EGtVV" /> gunmetal-[[Color/Legends|colored]] composite<ref name="FF114" /> [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] was located on the sides of the head, and it also had six [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]]: two pairs on the top and the third, largest pair extending forward from the head's lower part.<ref name="EGtVV" /> The creature also had wings that reached several hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="TotJC" /> and it could deliver a sting.<ref name="FF114" /> Its tan-colored [[exoskeleton]]<ref name="FF114" /> was thick enough to withstand [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts<ref name="EGtVV" /> as well as the lack of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure in outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and the high pressures involved in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel.<ref name="TotJC" />

Colossus wasps were adapted for traveling through space and between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], not requiring the intake of any [[Gas/Legends|gases]] to survive and suffering no ill effects from lack of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. The wasps fed on [[Star/Legends|stellar]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]<ref name="TotJC" /> and [[Cosmic ray/Legends|cosmic rays]]<ref name="FF114" /> as well as on raw proto-materials present in [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]],<ref name="TotJC" /> including [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]]. They also readily consumed any<ref name="FF114" /> creatures living on [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]<ref name="EGtVV" /> that they encountered,<ref name="FF114" /> particularly [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]],<ref name="TotJC" /> which could reach lengths of several hundred meters.<ref name="CSWE SpaceSlug">{{CSWECite|III|181|space slug (exogorth)}}</ref> Colossus wasps had a lifespan of several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]],<ref name="EGtVV" /> and when the creatures [[Death/Legends|died]], their bodies frequently remained drifting in space, slowly breaking down over the course of many [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]].<ref name="FF114" />

==Behavior==
Preferring to search for food in asteroid fields,<ref name="TotJC" /> colossus wasps migrated from [[Planet/Legends|world]] to world.<ref name="EGtVV" /> They spent eighteen of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Ithull]]'s [[Standard month/Legends|months]] offworld, returning during the remaining seven months to [[Reproduction/Legends|mate]], bear young, and teach the newborn wasps the fundamentals of survival.<ref name="TotJC" />

==History==
The colossus wasp roamed the [[Stenness Node]] region and was specifically native to<ref name="TotJC" /> the terrestrial<ref name="BH">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> planet Ithull<ref name="TotJC" /> of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Airon sector/Legends|Airon sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ithull system/Legends|Ithull system]]</ref> It was the best-known creature of its homeworld,<ref name="TotJC" /> and [[Gruna]], who [[Captain/Legends|captained]] an [[Ithullan ore hauler]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="TotJ4">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref> in [[3999 BBY]],<ref name="3999 BBY">{{InsiderCite|26|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth: A Guide to the ''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' Universe, Part 1}} dates the events of the three [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] issues of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (miniseries)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' miniseries]] centering on [[Nomi Sunrider]]&mdash;including [[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]], which features the appearances of both an [[Ithullan ore hauler]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gruna]] and [[Finhead Stonebone]]'s modified [[E-2 Asteroid Miner|ore-raiding starships]]&mdash;to 3,999 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[3999 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> wore a [[Gold/Legends|golden]] [[Necklace/Legends|pendant]] in the shape of a colossus wasp while on duty.<ref name="TotJ4" /> [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drones]], nearly two-meter-tall [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who were in existence [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, towered over their owners in a way that made them resemble colossus wasps.<ref name="FF54">{{FactFile|54|WOR 1-2|J9 Worker Drone}}</ref>

==Colossus wasps in the galaxy==
===A miners' idea===
[[File:IthullanOreHauler2-FF114.png|thumb|right|300px|Nessie miners of the Stenness Node thought of using colossus wasp husks to construct Ithullan ore haulers (pictured).]]
More than four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the drifting bodies of dead colossus wasps became a source of inspiration for the [[Miner/Legends|miners]]<ref name="FF114" /> of the [[Nessie]]s,<ref name="EGtVV" /> a group of twenty-five [[Species/Legends|species]] inhabiting the Stenness Node.<ref name="CSWE StennessNode">{{CSWECite|III|191|Stenness Node}}</ref> Constantly having to adapt new starships for the transportation of<ref name="FF114" /> the [[mutonium]]<ref name="EGtVV" /> [[Ore/Legends|ore]] they [[Mining/Legends|collected]] to hyperspace [[Space station/Legends|terminals]] for dispersal into the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the miners realized that the colossus wasp [[Skeleton/Legends|exoskeletons]] were well-suited for transformation into [[Ore hauler|cargo vessels]].<ref name="FF114" />

At one point, a group of enterprising [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineers]] discovered the resilience of the wasps' exoskeleton against the rigors of hyperspace travel. Over subsequent decades of research and application of the fields of biology, chemistry, and [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgy]], the [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] designed a theoretical model for a [[Freighter/Legends|starship]]&mdash;the Ithullan ore hauler&mdash;that used the exoskeleton of the colossus wasp as its foundational structure. The model showed promising results in [[Computer/Legends|computer]] simulations, after which wasp [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] sought to obtain a carcass of the giant insect for use in constructing a prototype of the vessel. They soon learned that the colossus wasps could most frequently be encountered in asteroid fields and subsequently scoured the asteroids of the Stenness Node while looking for dead wasp specimens. Ultimately,<ref name="TotJC" /> at some point by 3999 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]<ref name="3999 BBY" /> a successful prototype was built and tested, after which Nessie companies began the construction of the ships.<ref name="TotJC" />

===Converting insect into starship===
{{Main|Ithullan ore hauler}}
====Initial work====
[[File:IthullanOreHaulerTopView-FF114.png|thumb|left|300px|In order to transform a colossus wasp exoskeleton into an Ithullan ore hauler, the former was cleaned out and sectioned.]]
The appearance of the Ithullan ore haulers rendered them one of the most unique spacegoing craft in [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. The construction of each such vessel began with the messy process of cleaning out the innards of the colossus wasp. The internal organs were scraped out until only the hollow outer shell of the body remained, after which<ref name="FF114" /> the husk was sectioned to make room for<ref name="EGtVV" /> the interior framework, hydraulics,<ref name="TotJ4" /> and decks, and the ship's systems were installed. The complete refit that was done on the husk's interior led to it being difficult for an observer inside the ship to notice the unusual nature of the vessel,<ref name="FF114" /> although the inside surface of the exoskeleton itself could still be visible.<ref name="TotJ4" />

The command [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and the navigation and communications systems were all housed in the wasp's head.<ref name="FF114" /> Specifically, the command section was situated in the colossus wasp's eyes. The top of the head housed the central computers of the ship, and secondary computer stations were located in the space where the wasp's legs were connected to the thorax. The larger pair of the insect's antennae were converted into [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]],<ref name="EGtVV" /> while the thin secondary antennae served as [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizers]]. The upper legs of the exoskeleton were also outfitted with stabilizing [[Wing (technology)|wings]]<ref name="FF114" /> and [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering jets]]<ref name="EGtVV" /> for flight in planetary atmospheres, while the lower legs were left free for the purposes of landing the craft.<ref name="FF114" />

====Cargo space and defenses====
[[File:IthullanOreHaulerAft-FF114.png|thumb|right|300px|During the construction of an Ithullan ore hauler, engine units were attached to the outside of a colossus wasp's husk.]]
In order to maximize space available for holding ore, [[Ion engine/Legends|ion sublight engine]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] units were mounted outside the exoskeleton, along the lower abdomen section. The wasp's thorax was outfitted to hold the main ore holds, with additional space for storage available in the portions of the abdomen<ref name="FF114" /> not holding [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] pods, [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], or [[Engine/Legends|drive]] control systems.<ref name="EGtVV" /> The completed ore hauler averaged between 1<ref name="FF114" /> and 1.1 kilometers in length,<ref name="EGtVV" /> and its cargo capacity was five hundred [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]],<ref name="TotJC" /> rivaling that of the largest [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]].<ref name="EGtVV" />

The colossus wasp's naturally tough exoskeleton was augmented by [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating as well as [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]<ref name="FF114" /> for which the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generators]] were located on the upper forward section of the thorax.<ref name="EGtVV" /> The passive defenses were complemented by two [[Turbolaser/Legends|heavy turbolasers]]<ref name="TotJC" /> situated on the thorax close to the wasp's head<ref name="EGtVV" /> and twelve defensive blasters<ref name="TotJC" /> running along the entire length of the ship. To counteract the Ithullan ore haulers' defenses,<ref name="EGtVV" /> at some point by 3999 BBY,<ref name="3999 BBY" /> the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] captain [[Finhead Stonebone]]'s engineers modified the high-powered [[Plasma drill/Legends|plasma drills]] of a pair of [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] [[E-2 Asteroid Miner]] starships so that they could penetrate the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ore haulers and therefore allow the pirates to steal the valuable ores transported by the vessels.<ref name="EGtVV" />

===Consequences for the wasps===
[[File:IthullanOreHauler-TotJ4.jpg|thumb|left|300px|A colossus wasp&ndash;turned&ndash;Ithullan ore hauler in 3999 BBY]]
The entire process of both acquiring a colossus wasp husk and converting it into an Ithullan ore hauler was so costly that the vessels were only ever commissioned on an individual basis and not mass-produced. The fitting out of the ships was usually carried out by bio-engineers and bio-[[Technician/Legends|technicians]] who simultaneously conducted experiments on the interactions between the exoskeleton and the various chemicals and electronics involved in the conversion process.<ref name="TotJC" />

Although the companies that manufactured the ore haulers claimed that they only used naturally occurring husks of dead colossus wasps in the ships' manufacture,<ref name="TotJC" /> it was well-known that certain mining [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] paid top price for the creatures' exoskeletons, leading to the emergence of colossus wasp poaching in asteroid fields&mdash;a dangerous enterprise to the hunters themselves due to the threat posed by the giant insects when they were defending themselves.<ref name="EGtVV" /> Several groups of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] eventually came to suspect that at least a small percentage of colossus wasps were actively hunted and killed for their exoskeletons.<ref name="TotJC" /> At some point, the use of the wasps in the manufacture of the Ithullan ore haulers had led the creatures to becoming scarce or possibly even extinct.<ref name="FF114" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My biggest fun was drawing this vast organic spacecraft. We were told if any of our designs got picked up for a film we'd get paid extra, but I'm still waiting! I mostly drew what I thought would look good and crossed my fingers, hoping they'd like it.|David Roach|<ref name="SW151">{{InsiderCite|151|Authors of the Expanded Universe|Authors of the Expanded Universe: More ''Tales of the Jedi''}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tojkotor4cover.jpg|thumb|right|290px|The colossus wasp was introduced in ''Tales of the Jedi'' 4.]]
The colossus wasp first appeared, in the form of an exoskeleton converted into an Ithullan ore hauler, in the [[Tales of the Jedi 4|fourth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue was written by [[Tom Veitch]] and penciled by [[David Roach]]<ref name="TotJ4" /> and published on [[January 18]], [[1994]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54569/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_1993_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (1993) #4}}</ref> Roach, who penciled two issues for the ''Tales of the Jedi'' series, later stated that the Ithullan ore hauler had been inspired by real-world [[Wikipedia:Hornet|hornets]] and that he found drawing the panels featuring the spacecraft to be the most enjoyable of all.<ref name="SW151" />

The first installment of the [[The Horse's Mouth|''A Guide to the Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi Universe'']] series of articles written by [[Bob Cooper]], published in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars Insider 26|twenty-sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, provided the first clear spelling of the colossus wasp's name, using the capitalization "Colossus Wasp"<ref name="Insider26">{{InsiderCite|26|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth: A Guide to the ''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' Universe, Part 1}}</ref> that was subsequently used by several other ''[[Star Wars]]'' sources.<ref name="CSWE StennessNode" /><ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Later, ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', a [[1996]] reference book authored by [[Bill Smith]], was the first source to use the lower-case name "colossus wasp,"<ref name="EGtVV" /> which has since been used by the majority of the media referencing the creature.<ref name="TotJC" /><ref name="FF114" /><ref name="CSWE Ithull" /><ref name="CSWE ColossusWasp" /><ref name="CSWE IthullanOreHauler" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="BtM" /><ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref><ref name="FF11">{{FactFile|11|PLA 7-8|Planets of the Inner Rim}}</ref><ref name="NEGtVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref><ref name="CSWE MarauderStarjacker">{{CSWECite|II|288|''Marauder Starjacker''}}</ref>

The book was also the first to identify colossus wasps by the name "Ithullian colossus wasp,"<ref name="EGtVV" /> although, beginning with [[1998]]'s ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="SWE" /> the spelling of that name, as used in the more recent ''Star Wars'' sources, has shifted to "Ithullan colossus wasp."<ref name="CSWE IthullanOreHauler" /><ref name="BtM" /><ref name="FF11" /><ref name="NEGtVV" /><ref name="CSWE MarauderStarjacker" /> In addition, ''The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels'' in two instances incorrectly states that Captain Finhead Stonebone used his modified E-2 Asteroid Miner starships to carry out raids on colossus wasps themselves, as opposed to on the Ithullan ore haulers constructed out of the wasps' bodies.<ref name="EGtVV" /> The creature's name was misspelled as "Illuthan colossus wasp" in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 54|fifty-fourth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine,<ref name="FF54" /> which was written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and published around [[January 8]], [[2003]].<ref name="FF54Date">{{FFdates|54}}</ref> The misspelling was repeated in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 59|fifty-ninth issue]] of the magazine's [[2014]] [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|re-make edition]],<ref name="FF59">{{FactFile2014|59|WOR 1-2|J9 worker drone}}</ref> also written by Lowson,<ref name="FF Author" /> with that issue being released around [[February 25]], [[2015]].<ref name="FF59Date">{{FactFile2014Dates|59}}</ref>
